title: Herbalism Basics
description: Sage Brennan has tended Elder Moor's cuts and fevers for thirty years, and some mornings his hands shake too badly to grind fine. He wants one more set of hands in camp that knows red herb from rot.

objectives.description: Speak with Sage Brennan about why he's teaching a stranger
Brew a Health Potion at the alchemy table

notes: Tutorial; no threat by design per spec. Giver motive supplied: Brennan is aging and short-handed for winter. Brennan's shaking hands invented for this quest only - no bible basis, local colour.
